worlds.name: The Whitereach
worlds.blurb: A frozen tundra with three warm valley towns, each with a gentle climate of its own.

worlds.name: Kestrel Reach
worlds.blurb: An airless, low-gravity moon with a farming dome, a spinning ring and a suited outpost.

worlds.name: Verdance Basin
worlds.blurb: Rainforest river country: stilt houses, a treetop market and a quiet logging village.

worlds.name: Monsoon Coast
worlds.blurb: A hot, stormy coast of fishing towns, rice terraces and an old lantern-lit port.

worlds.name: Harborside
worlds.blurb: A small seaside town with a working quay, a lantern market and a lighthouse.

worlds.name: The Long Road
worlds.blurb: A road across the plains that climbs into the hills and dips into dry country.

worlds.name: Greenhollow Estate
worlds.blurb: A country estate with house lore, and rooms that add lore of their own.
